vertical.edit: The big balloon becomes a giant knotted rubber balloon full of sloshing water, bulging at the bottom; fat drops fall onto the hanging man, who squints up, soaked. Same pen-and-ink style, same pose.

vertical.edit: The balloon becomes a huge twisted balloon dog (sausage-shaped segments, knot nose) floating sideways in the clouds; the man hangs from a string tied to one of its legs. Same ink style and pose.

horizontal.caption: to blow up a balloon
horizontal.edit: The balloon is only half full and limp; the man stands below it on a little cloud, blowing hard into its neck with huge puffed cheeks. Same ink style.

horizontal.caption: to pop a balloon
horizontal.edit: A small bird pecks the balloon and it bursts: jagged rubber shreds and bang lines fly out, the rope goes slack and the man looks up, eyes wide, starting to drop. No text, no sound words.
